findings.title: Claim form amount differs from bill totals
findings.detail: The claim form states an amount claimed of 60904.07, whereas the hospital bill total is 60540.07 and the pharmacy bill is 364.00, yielding a sum of 60904.07, but the hospital bill total payable on the bill itself is 60540.07.

findings.title: Missing lab report for complete blood count
findings.detail: The hospital bill includes investigation charges, but there is no separate billing line matching the complete blood count report, or alternatively, investigation reports lack a matching itemized bill detail.

findings.title: Clinical course mentions procedure without separate procedure report document
findings.detail: The clinical course describes a laparoscopic appendicectomy, but no standalone operative theatre notes document is attached.

findings.title: Pharmacy bill location mismatch
findings.detail: The pharmacy bill is from CarePlus Chemists in Noida, whereas the hospital is in Bengaluru.

findings.title: Admission date mismatch between claim form and hospital records
findings.detail: The claim form lists the admission date as 05/09/2024, whereas the hospital bill and discharge summary state 09 Sep 2024.

findings.title: No identity discrepancies found
findings.detail: Patient name Advik Maharaj, age 68, and sex M are consistent across all documents.
